summary: First test of public stall catalog + online registration + admin confirmation under /dashboard/*. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (public lapak-kosong w/o PII, 401 on admin endpoints, unit CRUD + duplicate 409, register->terima creates LPK-JMB tenant + auto-reject other pending + stall disappears from public, 409 on occupied stall and on re-accept, expiry (selesai in past) and status berhenti free the stall, tolak + double-tolak 409, terima invalid dates 422, 404/422 validation, 5/hour rate limit 429). Frontend: public page (hero, count, filters, cards, Daftar dialog -> daftar-sukses with correct wa.me/6281234567890 link incl. /dashboard/pendaftaran URL), unauth redirects (/dashboard, /dashboard/scan-qr, /lapak, /pengaturan -> /login), login -> /dashboard, all 8 nav links under /dashboard/*, badge-pendaftaran-baru count, terima dialog prefilled dates + toast 'X kini penyewa LPK-JMB-017', sibling registration auto 'ditolak', tolak via UI, katalog add/edit/delete unit + Kosong/Terisi s.d. status, public page updates, topbar-btn-halaman-publik, mobile layout, QR scan regression (LPK-JMB-001 -> penagih -> Sudah Bayar -> LUNAS toast). All core flows PASS; only security/robustness issues found.

critical.issue: Rate limit (5/IP/hour) is trivially bypassable: lib/ratelimit.client_ip() trusts the FIRST X-Forwarded-For entry, which is client-controlled and passed through by the ingress. Verified via public URL: 9+ registrations in a row succeeded by sending random X-Forwarded-For headers. Same weakness applies to the login brute-force guard. Fix: use the last (proxy-appended) XFF hop / a trusted-proxy count, or X-Real-IP set by ingress.

minor.issue: Allows deleting a unit that is currently occupied (verified: deleted TEST unit while tenant LPK-JMB-017 was active) and leaves pending 'baru' registrations orphaned (later terima -> 404). Consider blocking delete when terisi or auto-rejecting its pending registrations.

Renaming blok of an occupied unit breaks the blok-string link to the tenant -> stall instantly shows 'kosong' on public page while still rented. Occupancy also depends on exact string match (case/whitespace) between lapak_units.blok and tenants.blok.
Not atomic: _cek_kosong + insert tenant + status update are separate ops; two concurrent accepts for the same stall can both create tenants. Use find_one_and_update({id, status:'baru'}) as a guard.
No dedupe: same phone can register repeatedly for the same stall (only limited by the bypassable rate limit).

ui_bugs.issue: window.open(waLink) is called in mutation onSuccess (after async request) - not a user gesture, so popup blockers block it (0 popups opened in test). Fallback button btn-kirim-wa-admin works, so low impact; consider relying on the button only or opening a blank window synchronously on submit.

issues: Clicking 'Lihat lapak kosong' (#katalog anchor) scrolls the 'Lapak tersedia' heading under the sticky header (add scroll-mt-20 to #katalog section)
btn-kirim-wa-admin has bg-emerald-600 class but renders dark slate (class merged/overridden by buttonVariants) - WhatsApp green intent lost

Nested testids 'lapak-card-blok'/'lapak-card-tarif' share the 'lapak-card-' prefix with card container testids 'lapak-card-{id}' -> prefix selectors return 3x cards; consider renaming to 'lapak-blok'/'lapak-tarif'

action_items: Fix client_ip() X-Forwarded-For spoofing so pendaftaran rate limit (and login guard) cannot be bypassed
Guard DELETE /lapak-unit when stall is occupied / auto-reject its pending registrations
Make terima atomic (conditional update on status 'baru') to avoid double tenants
Optional: handle blok rename for occupied units; add scroll-margin to #katalog; make WA button green; remove reliance on window.open after async

Public LapakPublik response model correctly strips tenant data; admin GET /pendaftaran excludes ip field - good
